name: site2md
solution: `build` converts the page, `extract` runs a minimal Extractor written for this benchmark, and one last step writes the record values. The crawl runs `build` in site mode with `--max-pages 20 --max-depth 2` and reuses the same Extractor across the document's source sections. site2md is installed from its release tag, because the PyPI name belongs to a different project.

footnotes.text: site2md waits one second from the start of one request to the start of the next, as its traversal policy says. It times that second with `time.monotonic()`, which ticks every 15.6 ms on Windows under Python 3.12, so it can start a child request up to about one tick early, and the shortest gap in the server's log can be slightly under one second.
